intent: Individually authored science vocabulary tasks preserve experimental conditions, amount comparisons and action constraints.
picturePurpose: Original single-plant art moves only under coded controls to teach observing without moving; separate record examples teach each, and event ordering teaches before.

workshop.instruction: 原位观察、补齐记录、排好先后；每次只做一件事。

transfer.stem: Which plan follows all three instructions?
transfer.passage:
A careful observation plan
Our experiment compared seeds in light and shade. It recorded the conditions, not a winning group. A method used less water for cleaning brushes, but it did not use zero water or state a percentage saved. A diagram showed the process of making paper, not a price list. The watering system used collected rainwater, and the water cycle moved water through the environment.
We were told to observe the plants without moving the pots. A separate fictional picture used one plant to show two possible actions; it did not establish how many pots were in the original sentence. We should leave the pots in place while observing.
We also had to record the time beside each measurement. In a separate format exercise, two entries included times and one did not. Those invented entries were not experimental results. Finally, we needed a shelf for an opening. We had to measure the opening before buying the shelf, not buy first and measure later.

options.text: Observe without moving the pots; record a time beside every measurement; measure the opening before buying.
Move the pots before observing; record all times; measure before buying.
Observe without moving; record a time beside only one measurement; measure before buying.
Observe without moving; record all times; buy the shelf before measuring.

answer.display: Observe without moving the pots; record a time beside every measurement; measure the opening before buying.
